title: Preserve uncertain verification delivery in the run-wait follow-up when artifacts are unavailable
outcome: The run-wait follow-up reports that verification delivery is unconfirmed when a resend may have reached Engram and local artifacts prevent reconciliation.
acceptance: A run with an uncertain verification resend and changed or missing local artifacts shows delivery as unconfirmed in its follow-up. Its message explains that local evidence prevents reconciliation.
A behavioral run-wait regression exercises a lost reply followed by missing or modified terminal artifacts.
